title: conduit.json
description: Project-level configuration for Conduit. Drop this file in a project's root to declare runnable scripts and workspace defaults.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the file.

scripts.description: Commands runnable from the Scripts tab. Keys are the names shown in the list; declaration order drives display order. Prefer the object form and give every script a description. A script named "setup" also runs automatically in every new worktree, from the worktree's root, and one named "teardown" runs when a worktree is archived.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for { "command": "..." }, accepted for compatibility. Prefer the object form: a script with no description falls back to showing its own command twice.

command.description: Shell command, run from the project directory on the remote host via a login shell.

description.description: One-line summary shown under the script name. Defaults to the command if omitted, which reads poorly — write a real one.

interactive.description: Run under a PTY with a key composer, for long-running processes that read stdin (watchers, REPLs, flutter run).

oneOf.description: A script. Give it a command and a description.

settings.description: The folder's defaults, edited by its Settings in Conduit. A worktree follows the main checkout's copy, falling back to its own.

devServerCommand.description: Command the Server tab runs for this project.

interactiveServer.description: Run the dev server under a PTY with a key composer. Null defers to the app's per-workspace setting.

defaultModel.description: Model for new and resumed sessions. An alias or a full model id.

permissionMode.description: How Claude handles tool-use approvals. Null prompts for each tool use.

defaultModeAfterPlan.description: Permission mode to switch to once Claude's plan is accepted. Null means acceptEdits.

diffBaseRef.description: Ref the Diff tab compares against. Null detects it from origin/HEAD.
